title: Stalk factorization of normalized affine-line supported restriction
statement:
Fix a finite purity setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], with coefficient ring $A$, positive level $n$ and $h:e(P)\mid n$. Let $a:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be separated and of finite type, and let $s:Y\hookrightarrow\mathbf A^1_Y$ be the zero section. Write $G=Rs^!A_{\mathbf A^1_Y}(1)[2]$ for the actual finite exceptional value of [lem-pur-gysin-structure]. Let $D$ be normalized support data of [thm-pur-affine-line-orientation], so $D.\mathrm{support}:\Gamma(Y,\mathcal H^0G)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^2_{s(Y)}(\mathbf A^1_Y,A(1))$ is its specified chart. Let $H$ be an etale sheaf of $A$-modules and $e:\nu_Y^*H\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal H^0G$. For a map $b:A_{Y,\mathrm{et}}\to H$, let $v_b=\operatorname{ev}_1(\nu_Y^*b\mathbin{\gg}e)$, using the evaluation of [lem-pur-gysin-structure]. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed $k$-field in the scheme universe. The symbol $1_y$ denotes the canonical germ of $1$ in the constant-sheaf stalk, as in [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-pullback-stalk]. Let $y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be any scheme morphism. For every normalized pro-etale supported-pair transport $p$ for the induced affine-line square, as defined by [lem-pur-supported-hom-pullback], there exists an $A$-linear map
$$\alpha:H_y\longrightarrow H^2_{s(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega)}(\mathbf A^1_\Omega,A(1))$$
such that, for every $b:A_{Y,\mathrm{et}}\to H$,
$$\alpha(b_y(1_y))=r_y^p(D.\mathrm{support}(v_b)).$$
Here $r_y^p$ is the actual kernel-derived supported restriction with the canonical coefficient pullback of [thm-pur-affine-line-orientation]. No finite-type condition is imposed on $\Omega$, and $y$ need not respect its given $k$-algebra structure.

source.place: Step 2, sentence: the map of the statement is exactly the stalkwise evaluation of the section. The construction uses the supported Ext identification and functoriality in Milne, Lectures on Etale Cohomology, Theorem 9.4 and Example 9.5, and the exact stalk pullback in Step 3.

proof.text: By [lem-pur-gysin-structure], lift the comparison between H and its locally constant etale Gysin model, then choose a trivializing cover member above y. The geometric stalk is an A-line. The orientation theorem gives a fibre residue isomorphism, so the target support is an A-line as well. Induce the k-algebra structure on Omega from y followed by a to apply the fibre normalization.

Define linear maps ev(b)=b_y(1) and r(b)=the specified supported restriction. Evaluation is linear by scalar compatibility of the stalk functor. Unfolding the two adjunction Hom equivalences shows gysinEvaluate is linear. By [lem-pur-affine-line-support-restriction-zero-germ], ker(ev) is contained in ker(r).

The kernel inclusion and the unique terminal arrow show independence of normalized transport: compose supportUnit_spec with its monic kernel inclusion, then derive. Use the Hom-to-sections bijection to choose m with its D-supported class equal to the global normalized orientation class in D0. Fullness of comparison gives b0 lifting H0(m) followed by e inverse. Consequently rho(r(b0))=1.

Put t:A -> H_y, t(c)=c*ev(b0). If t(c)=0 then kernel containment gives r(c*b0)=0, and applying rho gives c=0. Compose with line coordinates to get an injective self-map of the finite ring A, hence a bijective one. Thus t is a linear isomorphism. Define alpha as rho inverse after t inverse. Apply kernel containment to b-t_inverse(ev(b))*b0; applying rho gives rho(r(b))=t_inverse(ev(b)). This is precisely alpha(ev(b))=r(b). The finite-line factorization is proved in Lean, including the zero-ring case.

proof_origin.place: Step 2 reduced to local zero-germ vanishing; the linear factorization is proved using finite coefficients and the normalized orientation.

theorem affineLine_support_stalk_map (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (h : P.ramificationIndex ∣ P.level) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (a : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated a] [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a]
    (D : OrientationSupportData P h Y)
    (H : ProEtale.RetractedSupport.EtSheaves P Y)
    (e : (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).obj H ≅
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ProEtale.RetractedSupport.ProSheaves P Y) 0).obj (P.gysinValue h Y))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra P.field.k Ω]
    (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
    (p : proEtaleSupportHomTransport P (zeroSection Y)
      (zeroSection (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω))) (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) y)) :
    ∃ α : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber.obj H ⟶
        P.gysinSupport h (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)),
      ∀ b : P.constantEtale Y ⟶ H,
        α (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber.map b)
          (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiberConstantSheafIso
            (ModuleCat.of P.Coefficient P.Coefficient)).inv 1)) =
          P.orientationSupportRestriction h y p
            (D.support.hom (P.gysinEvaluate Y
              ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).map b ≫
                e.hom)))
